mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which is a stronger predictor of negative S&P 500 returns than either series alone over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of such joint decline periods.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 100), a decline in industrial production signals a weakening economy that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) indicates strong housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that typically triggers a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market that is a stronger predictor of negative S&P 500 returns than either indicator alone over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of such joint events.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active Federal Reserve tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% annually), the resulting increase in real interest rates compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 1.0%.
